front: Elle est chercheuse au CNRS.
pronunciation: [el eh shehr-SHUHZ oh say-en-ehr-ES]
back: She's a researcher at the CNRS.
context: The Centre national de la recherche scientifique is Europe's largest public research body.

front: Pasteur a mis au point le vaccin contre la rage en 1885.
pronunciation: [pas-TUHR ah mee zoh PWAN luh vak-SAN kohn-truh lah RAHZH ahn meel wee-sahn kah-truh-van-SANK]
back: Pasteur developed the rabies vaccine in 1885.
context: 'Mettre au point' = to develop. The Institut Pasteur was founded in 1887.

front: Marie Curie est la seule personne à avoir reçu deux prix Nobel scientifiques différents.
pronunciation: [mah-ree kü-REE eh lah suhl pehr-sun ah ah-vwahr ruh-SÜ duh pree noh-BEL syahn-tee-FEEK dee-fay-RAHN]
back: Marie Curie is the only person to have won Nobel Prizes in two different sciences.
context: Physics in 1903, chemistry in 1911.

front: Emmanuelle Charpentier a codécouvert les ciseaux génétiques.
pronunciation: [ay-mah-nü-el shar-pahn-TYAY ah koh-day-koo-vehr lay see-zoh zhay-nay-TEEK]
back: Emmanuelle Charpentier co-discovered the genetic scissors.
context: CRISPR-Cas9: Nobel Prize in Chemistry 2020, shared with Jennifer Doudna.

front: L'étude a été publiée dans une revue à comité de lecture.
pronunciation: [lay-tüd ah ay-tay pü-blee-AY dahn zün ruh-vü ah koh-mee-tay duh lek-TÜR]
back: The study was published in a peer-reviewed journal.
context: 'Une revue à comité de lecture' = peer-reviewed journal.

front: L'essai clinique a été mené en double aveugle.
pronunciation: [leh-say klee-NEEK ah ay-tay muh-nay ahn doo-blah-VUH-gluh]
back: The clinical trial was double-blind.
context: 'Mener un essai' = to conduct a trial.

front: Le groupe témoin a reçu un placebo.
pronunciation: [luh groop tay-MWAN ah ruh-sü an plah-say-BOH]
back: The control group received a placebo.
context: 'Un groupe témoin' = a control group.

front: Ces résultats restent à confirmer.
pronunciation: [say ray-zül-TAH rest tah kohn-feer-MAY]
back: These results have yet to be confirmed.
context: 'Rester à' + infinitive = still to be done.

front: L'échantillon n'est pas représentatif.
pronunciation: [lay-shahn-tee-YOHN neh pah ruh-pray-zahn-tah-TEEF]
back: The sample isn't representative.
context: 'Un échantillon' = a sample.

front: Le patient doit donner son consentement éclairé.
pronunciation: [luh pah-SYAHN dwah doh-nay sohn kohn-sahnt-mahn ay-kleh-RAY]
back: The patient must give informed consent.
context: 'Éclairé' = enlightened, informed.

front: Le Comité consultatif national d'éthique a rendu son avis.
pronunciation: [luh koh-mee-tay kohn-sül-tah-teef nah-syoh-nal day-TEEK ah rahn-dü soh nah-VEE]
back: The national ethics committee has delivered its opinion.
context: The CCNE, created in 1983, was the world's first national bioethics committee.

front: La PMA est ouverte à toutes les femmes depuis 2021.
pronunciation: [lah pay-em-AH eh too-vehrt ah toot lay FAM duh-pwee duh-meel-van-tay-AN]
back: Assisted reproduction has been open to all women since 2021.
context: PMA = procréation médicalement assistée. Includes single women and lesbian couples.

front: La gestation pour autrui reste interdite en France.
pronunciation: [lah zhes-tah-SYOHN poor oh-TRWEE rest an-tehr-DEET ahn FRAHNS]
back: Surrogacy remains banned in France.
context: 'La GPA'. A recurring bioethics debate.

front: Le débat sur la fin de vie divise la société.
pronunciation: [luh day-BAH sür lah fan duh VEE dee-veez lah soh-syay-TAY]
back: The end-of-life debate divides society.
context: Parliament has been debating an 'aide à mourir' (assisted dying) law.

front: La loi autorise une sédation profonde et continue jusqu'au décès.
pronunciation: [lah lwah oh-toh-reez ün say-dah-SYOHN proh-fohnd ay kohn-tee-NÜ zhüs-koh day-SEH]
back: The law allows deep, continuous sedation until death.
context: The Claeys-Leonetti law (2016), for terminally ill patients.

front: En France, chacun est présumé donneur d'organes.
pronunciation: [ahn FRAHNS, shah-kan eh pray-zü-may duh-nuhr dor-GAN]
back: In France, everyone is presumed to be an organ donor.
context: Unless you sign the national refusal register.

front: Onze vaccins sont obligatoires pour les enfants nés depuis 2018.
pronunciation: [ohnz vak-SAN sohn toh-blee-gah-TWAHR poor lay zahn-fahn nay duh-pwee duh-meel-dee-WEET]
back: Eleven vaccines are compulsory for children born since 2018.
context: Up from three before 2018.

front: Le principe de précaution est inscrit dans la Constitution.
pronunciation: [luh pran-seep duh pray-koh-SYOHN eh tan-skree dahn lah kohn-stee-tü-SYOHN]
back: The precautionary principle is enshrined in the Constitution.
context: Through the 2005 Environment Charter.

front: Les OGM font l'objet d'un vif débat.
pronunciation: [lay zoh-zhay-EM fohn lob-zheh dan veef day-BAH]
back: GMOs are the subject of heated debate.
context: OGM = organismes génétiquement modifiés. Growing them is banned in France.

front: Les déserts médicaux se multiplient à la campagne.
pronunciation: [lay day-zehr may-dee-KOH suh mül-tee-plee ah lah kahm-PAN-yuh]
back: Medical deserts are spreading in rural areas.
context: 'Un désert médical' = an area with too few doctors.

front: Il faut attendre six mois pour voir un ophtalmologue.
pronunciation: [eel foh tah-tahn-druh see MWAH poor vwahr an nof-tal-moh-LOG]
back: You have to wait six months to see an eye doctor.
context: Long waits for specialists are a common complaint.

front: Ce médecin pratique des dépassements d'honoraires.
pronunciation: [suh mayd-SAN prah-teek day day-pas-mahn doh-noh-REHR]
back: This doctor charges above the standard rate.
context: 'Secteur 2' doctors can charge more than the Sécu rate.

front: Le trou de la Sécu se creuse chaque année.
pronunciation: [luh troo duh lah say-KÜ suh kruhz shak ah-NAY]
back: The Social Security deficit grows every year.
context: 'Le trou de la Sécu' = the health insurance deficit, a perennial news topic.

front: Le pharmacien m'a proposé un générique.
pronunciation: [luh far-mah-SYAN mah proh-poh-zay an zhay-nay-REEK]
back: The pharmacist offered me a generic.
context: Pharmacists substitute generics by default.

front: Les antibiotiques, c'est pas automatique.
pronunciation: [lay zahn-tee-byoh-TEEK, seh pah zoh-toh-mah-TEEK]
back: Antibiotics aren't automatic.
context: A famous 2002 public health campaign against antibiotic overuse.

front: L'antibiorésistance est une menace majeure.
pronunciation: [lahn-tee-byoh-ray-zees-TAHNS eh tün muh-nas mah-ZHUHR]
back: Antibiotic resistance is a major threat.
context: A long but logical compound word.

front: L'automédication peut s'avérer dangereuse.
pronunciation: [loh-toh-may-dee-kah-SYOHN puh sah-vay-ray dahnzh-RUHZ]
back: Self-medication can prove dangerous.
context: 'S'avérer' = to turn out, prove to be.

front: Depuis 2017, les paquets de cigarettes sont neutres.
pronunciation: [duh-pwee duh-meel-dee-SET, lay pah-keh duh see-gah-RET sohn NUH-truh]
back: Since 2017, cigarette packets have been plain.
context: Plain packaging with large health warnings.

front: Le Nutri-Score aide à choisir des aliments plus sains.
pronunciation: [luh nü-tree-SKOR ed ah shwah-zeer day zah-lee-mahn plü SAN]
back: The Nutri-Score helps you choose healthier food.
context: A French-designed A–E label now used in several countries.

front: L'espérance de vie dépasse quatre-vingt-cinq ans pour les femmes.
pronunciation: [les-pay-rahns duh VEE day-pas kah-truh-van-SANK AHN poor lay FAM]
back: Life expectancy exceeds 85 for women.
context: About 80 for men: one of the widest gender gaps in Europe.

front: Le vieillissement de la population pèse sur le système de santé.
pronunciation: [luh vyeh-yees-mahn duh lah poh-pü-lah-SYOHN pez sür luh sees-tem duh sahn-TAY]
back: The aging population is straining the health system.
context: 'Peser sur' = to weigh on.

front: La santé mentale a été déclarée grande cause nationale.
pronunciation: [lah sahn-tay mahn-TAL ah ay-tay day-klah-ray grahnd kohz nah-syoh-NAL]
back: Mental health was declared a national cause.
context: In 2025. A 'grande cause nationale' gets free public-service advertising.

front: Les gestes barrières sont rentrés dans les mœurs.
pronunciation: [lay zhest bah-RYEHR sohn rahn-tray dahn lay MUHRS]
back: Protective habits have become second nature.
context: 'Les gestes barrières' (handwashing, masks, coughing into your elbow) date from Covid.

front: Le premier confinement a commencé le 17 mars 2020.
pronunciation: [luh pruh-myay kohn-feen-MAHN ah koh-mahn-SAY luh dee-SET mars duh-meel-van]
back: The first lockdown began on March 17, 2020.
context: 'Le confinement' = lockdown; 'le déconfinement' = easing it.

front: Un vaccin à ARN messager a été développé en moins d'un an.
pronunciation: [an vak-SAN ah ah-ehr-EN meh-sah-ZHAY ah ay-tay dayv-loh-PAY ahn mwan dan NAHN]
back: An mRNA vaccine was developed in less than a year.
context: ARN = acide ribonucléique (RNA).

front: La recherche fondamentale manque de financements.
pronunciation: [lah ruh-shersh fohn-dah-mahn-TAL mahnk duh fee-nahns-MAHN]
back: Basic research lacks funding.
context: France spends about 2.2% of GDP on research.

front: Beaucoup de jeunes chercheurs partent à l'étranger.
pronunciation: [boh-koo duh zhuhn shehr-SHUHR part ah lay-trahn-ZHAY]
back: Many young researchers go abroad.
context: 'La fuite des cerveaux' = brain drain.

front: Corrélation n'est pas causalité.
pronunciation: [koh-ray-lah-SYOHN neh pah koh-zah-lee-TAY]
back: Correlation is not causation.
context: The golden rule of reading scientific news.

front: Cette théorie n'a jamais été réfutée.
pronunciation: [set tay-oh-REE nah zhah-meh ay-tay ray-fü-TAY]
back: This theory has never been refuted.
context: 'Réfuter' = to disprove.

front: L'intelligence artificielle aide déjà à détecter certains cancers.
pronunciation: [lan-teh-lee-zhahns ar-tee-fee-SYEL ed day-ZHAH ah day-tek-tay sehr-tan kahn-SEH]
back: AI already helps detect some cancers.
context: Notably in reading mammograms and skin images.

front: Le séquençage du génome coûte de moins en moins cher.
pronunciation: [luh say-kahn-sahzh dü zhay-NOHM koot duh mwan zahn mwan SHEHR]
back: Genome sequencing is getting cheaper and cheaper.
context: 'De moins en moins' = less and less.

front: Les données de santé sont particulièrement sensibles.
pronunciation: [lay doh-nay duh sahn-TAY sohn par-tee-kü-lyehr-mahn sahn-SEE-bluh]
back: Health data is particularly sensitive.
context: Protected by the GDPR, 'le RGPD' in French.

front: Le serment d'Hippocrate engage le médecin à ne pas nuire.
pronunciation: [luh sehr-mahn dee-poh-KRAT ahn-gahzh luh mayd-SAN ah nuh pah NWEER]
back: The Hippocratic oath commits doctors to do no harm.
context: 'Nuire à' = to harm.

front: Science sans conscience n'est que ruine de l'âme.
pronunciation: [SYAHNS sahn kohn-SYAHNS neh kuh rü-een duh LAHM]
back: Science without conscience is but the ruin of the soul.
context: Rabelais, 'Pantagruel' (1532): the classic line on science and ethics.

front: Mieux vaut prévenir que guérir.
pronunciation: [myuh voh prayv-NEER kuh gay-REER]
back: Prevention is better than cure.
context: The motto of public health.
